description: Ministry of Sport and Youth Affairs - Duties and Function to the State Minister
categorisation: This gazette contains both a named individual (Hon. State Minister of Sports and Youth Affairs) and detailed portfolio responsibilities (specific duties, functions, departments, statutory institutions, projects, and laws/acts to be implemented as outlined in the three-column schedule). The content includes both "who" is being assigned responsibilities and "what" those detailed responsibilities are, making it a Hybrid Gazette according to the classification rules.
